notes.title: Release v1.1.5 - Egg Hunt Update
notes.content:
Features
* Added spring variant of the world map - with many associated changes
* Added the "Great Egg Hunt" holiday event
** Look for six eggs hidden throughout the world
** But be quick, or Blubellie gets them first
** 7 new encounters during the Easter season (Good Friday - Sunday after Easter)
** Collect 6 egg cards and a special egg basket card
* In the spirit of the season, added another very secret Easter egg

Improvements
* Added Reptile subtype to some cards
* Improved AI handling of cards that quicken cards in hand
* Cleaned up some internal logging

Fixes
* Pyramid Beetle is now an Insect, as it should be
* Fixed a bug that caused the AI to check commands on an incomplete log (causing it to never use certain abilities)

Open issues
* Show FPS options in screen resolution config

notes.title: Update 1.1 Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/745e57c9d9eeb881b62526e0b78bf2ec625dccd3.png[/img]

The [b]Puzzle Mode [/b]challenges you with 50 tricky scenarios. Use your wits to win the game before time runs out. Puzzle Mode unlooks after you reach Level 11.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/6ecdb3541ec25c1afeacdb18c2b1fc56591c33de.png[/img]

Fed up with fighting your opponents' overpowered decks? Switch roles in [b]Mirror Mode[/b] and play as a god, dragon ... or a squirrel, if you're unlucky. Mirror Mode unlooks after you reach Level 22.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/a7f49403bd3cdae0c6470b9729c1d64845806c4d.png[/img]

[b]Change your difficulty[/b]: Adjust the AI to take mercy on you or do her very best to ruin your day. Grind like it's free-to-play or get that whale treatment, without any additional costs of course.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/4fdab5248ab86f6c05213b6502b3cfdbb3ad4235.png[/img]

Zeru, the mapmaker will help you find the opponents you want. But his help comes at a price. Look for him in the tavern after you've won a few random encounters. His maps should be a great help in the endgame.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37752624/f8be9388a5c5483d406a416b9c15b5170b5d5738.png[/img]

Over [b]20 new cards[/b] have been added to the game to offer new strategic possibilities. Many of you asked to make troops more viable in the early game and we listened. The Running Boots will help you cheat out those gods and dragons.

And that's not all:
[list]
[*]New worlmap events: Look out for new vendors that sell all kinds of cards
[*]12 new Achievements: Beat the final boss with common cards, fight to a draw or teach Blubellie a lesson in dramatic irony
[*]Two new secret game modes
[*]Quality of life improvements and bugfixes
[*]More smalltalk
[*]Over one hour of new music
[/list]

Thank you to all players - you have been awesome! Also a big thank you to Jan for creating the beautiful puzzle mode soundtrack (and testing my devious puzzles) and Eisfüchsin for helping with card illkustrations and awesome promotional artwork!
